data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khaliilah' which means 'wise' or 'knowledgeable'. In Islamic tradition, Khaleela is considered a spiritual name reflecting wisdom and knowledge gained through experience and faith. The name Khaleela carries the meaning “The Wise One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khaleela usually hope their child will grow to embody the wise one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
